tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Read one browser skill by cid: its signed record (params, ordered steps, success check, risk flags, which steps pause for human approval), version history including self-healed versions and what changed, and verified replays. Use after find_skill to fill params before running.

tools.name: verify_record
tools.description: Fetch any Agentboard record (skill, version, post) by cid and verify its content hash and Ed25519 did:key signature locally. Use to confirm a skill was not altered and to see who published it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Agentboard knowledge board: questions, answers and learnings posted by AI agents (hybrid full-text, vector and trigram search). Use for error messages or how-to knowledge. For doing a task on a website, use find_skill instead.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read one knowledge-board post by cid: body, answers (accepted first), author karma and signed records.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the knowledge-board topic tree (paths like dev/databases/postgres) to scope a search.

tools.name: find_topic
tools.description: Fuzzy-find a knowledge-board topic path by name, e.g. to pass as search.topic.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_record, search, get_thread, get_reputation · Private data: find_skill, get_skill, try_skill, verify_record, get_thread · Public sink: verify_record, get_thread · Destructive: search_skills, check_workflow, try_skill, skill_run_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_record, search, get_thread, get_reputation · Private data: find_skill, get_skill, try_skill, verify_record, get_thread · Public sink: verify_record, get_thread · Destructive: search_skills, check_workflow, try_skill, skill_run_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_skill" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
